title: _In vitro_ human Th17 development
protocol: Isolate human PBMC from buffy coats of healthy donors by Ficoll hypaque density centrifugation.
Resuspend total PBMC in MACS buffer at a rate of 40 μl per 10 cells.
Incubate resuspended PBMC with Biotin-Antibody cocktail at a rate of 10 μl per 10 cells for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Add 30 μl of MACS buffer per 10 cells and incubate with Anti-Biotin Microbeads at a rate of 20 μl per 10 cells for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells with MACS buffer.
Resuspend washed cells in MACS buffer up to 500 μl per 10 cells.
Sort CD4+ T cells by two rounds of magnetic depletion on the AutoMACS using program Deplete S.
Wash isolated CD4+ T cells with MACS buffer.
Resuspend CD4+ T cells in MACS buffer at a rate of 80 μl per 10 cells.
Add CD45RO microbeads at a rate of 20 μl per 10 cells for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Isolate Naïve CD45RO- T cells by two rounds of depletion on the AutoMACS.
Culture naive CD4+ CD45RO- T cells at 1 × 10^5 cells/well in 96-well flat-bottom plates or 5 × 10^5 cells/well in 24-well plates for 5-6 days.
Add Yssel’s medium containing 1% human AB serum and appropriate cytokines to the cultures.
Coat beads with anti-CD3, anti-CD28, and anti-CD2 antibodies at a ratio of 1 bead/10 cells using T Cell Activation/Expansion Kit.
Collect and count cells after 5-6 days of culture.
Wash collected cells thoroughly.
Culture washed cells at 1 × 10^5 cells/well in 96-well flat-bottom plates or 5 × 10^5 cells/well in 24-well plates for an additional period of 5-6 days.
Add the indicated cytokines and IL-2 to the cultures during this second phase.
Count cells after 10-12 days of culture total.

Stimulate cells at 5 × 10^5 cells/ml with anti-CD3, anti-CD28, and anti-CD2 antibodies in the presence of IL-2 for 24 h to analyze gene expression or 48 h to assess cytokine levels in cell-free supernatants.
